title: Jetpack Compose
summary: Modern declarative UI toolkit for Android.
body: Jetpack Compose is Android’s modern toolkit for building native UI. It simplifies and accelerates UI development on Android with less code, powerful tools, and intuitive Kotlin APIs.

title: Kotlin
summary: A modern programming language for multiplatform development.
body: Kotlin is a cross-platform, statically typed, general-purpose programming language with type inference. Kotlin is designed to interoperate fully with Java.

title: Circuit
summary: A simple, reactive framework for building UI in Kotlin.
body: Circuit is a framework for building reactive UIs in Kotlin, designed with Compose in mind. It provides a structured way to manage state and navigation in complex applications.

title: Material Design 3
summary: The latest evolution of Material Design.
body: Material 3 is the latest version of Google’s open-source design system. Design and build beautiful, usable products with Material 3.

title: Coroutines
body: Coroutines are a design pattern for asynchronous programming that you can use on Android to simplify code that executes asynchronously.

title: Android Architecture Components
summary: Libraries for building robust, testable, and maintainable apps.
body: Architecture Components help you design robust, testable, and maintainable apps. They include Room, ViewModel, LiveData, and more.

title: Dependency Injection with Hilt
summary: Standard way to incorporate Dagger DI into Android apps.
body: Hilt provides a standard way to use DI in your application by providing containers for every Android class in your project and managing their lifecycles automatically.

title: Retrofit
summary: Type-safe HTTP client for Android and Java.
body: Retrofit turns your HTTP API into a Java interface. It makes it easy to consume JSON or XML data which is then parsed into objects.

title: Room Persistence Library
body: Room provides an abstraction layer over SQLite to allow fluent database access while harnessing the full power of SQLite.

title: WorkManager
body: WorkManager is the recommended solution for persistent work. It is background work that is scheduled to run even if the app exits or the device restarts.
